comment: Auto-generated skip_codegen patches for perl 5.34. Functions whose generated body fails to type-check on this perl version. 2026-08-22: re-evaluated after the add_decl / Pad* / token-annotation / string-concat fixes (apidoc data 1.3-1.5) by clearing the list and re-running the downstream libperl-sys build; only entries that still fail are kept, with specific reasons.

patches.name: CvDEPTH
patches.source_loc: embed.fnc CvDEPTH (AiMTp|I32 *|CvDEPTH|NN const CV * const sv)
patches.reason: The embed.fnc entry documents Perl_CvDEPTH (returns I32 *); the CvDEPTH macro derefs it (*Perl_CvDEPTH(...)) so the macro returns I32. On 5.36+ a name-only '=for apidoc CvDEPTH' in inline.h overwrites the typed entry during header scrape-merge, so the deref-inferred I32 wins there; <=5.34 lacks that comment and the raw I32 * leaks into the macro return constraint (generated `-> *mut I32` with a deref body, downstream E0308). The inline fn Perl_CvDEPTH itself is typed from its parsed C signature and is unaffected by this hint.
patches.upstream_status: n/a (entry attribution fix; masked by inline.h comment from 5.36)

patches.name: Perl_atof
patches.source_loc: perl-5.32/5.34 perl.h (#define Perl_atof(s) Perl_my_atof(s) under USE_PERL_ATOF)
patches.reason: The macro lacks aTHX_: Perl_my_atof takes (pTHX_ const char *s) on threaded builds, so the expansion is a 1-arg call to a 2-arg function (E0061). Latent in C because core code calls my_atof (embed.h adds aTHX_) instead. Fixed upstream in 5.36 (`Perl_my_atof(aTHX_ s)`). Same class as Perl_custom_op_xop in common.patches.json.

patches.name: SvPV_const
patches.reason: Return-position pointer cast gap: the body yields *mut c_void / *mut u8 where the declared return is *mut c_char (char* string macros with ternary/void* branches on this perl's SvPV macro shape). Candidate for a future codegen fix (cast insertion at return position); verified still failing after the 2026-08-22 re-evaluation (apidoc data 1.7).

patches.name: CopLINE
patches.source_loc: perl-5.34/5.36 cop.h (=for apidoc Am|STRLEN|CopLINE|const COP * c)
patches.reason: The =for apidoc annotation (added in the 5.34 cycle) mis-declares the return type as STRLEN, but the macro reads (c)->cop_line whose type is line_t (U32). The scraped header entry wins over body inference, so the generated fn was `-> STRLEN` with a U32 body (E0308). Fixing the dict entry also fixes CopLINE_inc/CopLINE_dec, whose return types are inferred from CopLINE (they have no apidoc annotation of their own). Replaces the former skip_codegen entries for CopLINE/CopLINE_dec/CopLINE_inc. <=5.32 has no annotation (pure inference, correct); 5.38 corrected the annotation to line_t upstream.
